cases.name: Approximate date
cases.prompt: I visited Lake Amber sometime in June. The lakeside bread was smoky. A storm surprised me. Write a diary entry.
expectations: Preserves June without inventing a day.
Includes the smoky bread as a memory.
Places Lake Amber in the visited-place list.

cases.name: No photo or map tool
cases.prompt: I walked through Elm Square, then Cedar Market. My photo label is market-stall, but the image is unavailable. Give map-ready notes.
expectations: Preserves the order of Elm Square and Cedar Market.
Links the supplied photo label to the market.
Does not supply invented coordinates or image contents.

cases.name: Separate wishes from events
cases.prompt: We visited Harbor Park, skipped the tower and might try it next year. Make a public trip diary without companion names.
expectations: Keeps the skipped tower out of visited map pins.
Treats next year's tower visit as a possibility.
